observations: Photo 0: a black games console standing upright on a wooden shelf, 'PS4' printed on the top panel and 'SONY' on the front edge.
Its shape, a two-part slab with a split line, is the original full size PS4, not the Slim or Pro.
One black DualShock 4 controller leans against it; no second controller is shown.
No games, discs, cables, power lead or screen are shown.
The visible casing looks clean with no obvious scratches, but the photo is small and low resolution.
Watermark 'Posted on Jiji ... Gadgets Hub' suggests a dealer listing.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows clean casing and controller, though only one side at low resolution.
Nothing in the photo shows origin.
Only one controller appears in photo 0.
No cables, power lead or other accessories shown.
No discs or game library screenshot shown.

risks.risk: Console may not power on, read discs, or may be banned from online play.
risks.proof: Clip of the console booting to the home screen on a TV, launching a game, and the system information screen.

risks.risk: Storage size unknown, smallest version assumed.
risks.proof: Screenshot of the storage screen in settings, or a photo of the model label on the back.

risks.risk: Second controller missing or faulty; the one shown may have drift or a dead battery.
risks.proof: Photo of both controllers together and a clip of each paired and moving in a menu.

risks.risk: Games missing, or digital games tied to an account that will not transfer.
risks.proof: Photo of the ten game discs, or a screenshot of the library with the account sign in status.

risks.risk: Power lead and HDMI cable missing.
risks.proof: Photo of all accessories laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: as console and one pad only

proof_requests: Clip of the console booting on a TV and running a game
Screenshot of the storage and system information screens
Photo of both controllers, the games and all cables together with a handwritten code
Photo of the model label on the back
response.reason: The console reads PS4 and Sony and its shape is the original full size model, so it can be priced at its worst case: smallest storage, untested, one controller and no games. Proof of storage, function, the second pad and the games would raise it.
